The '''Arch Pose''' was one of the many mediative stretching exercised practiced by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With the hands and feet placed firmly on the ground, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then arched their body into a rounded shape, with the buttocks as high as they could go.
